title: Keio IIIF Image API 2.0 Image Information
description: Structure of the image information document served by Keio University Media Center's IIIF Image API host iiif.lib.keio.ac.jp (IIPImage). Derived field-by-field from a live response, not from the IIIF specification text, so it describes what this deployment actually returns.

x-provenance.source: https://iiif.lib.keio.ac.jp/iipsrv/GTB/tif/000a.tif/info.json (HTTP 200, application/json, fetched 2026-09-01); raw response saved to examples/keio-iiif-image-info.json

@context.description: IIIF Image API 2 JSON-LD context. Observed value is fixed for this deployment.

@id.description: Canonical base URI of this image on the Keio image server, e.g. https://iiif.lib.keio.ac.jp/iipsrv/GTB/tif/000a.tif

width.description: Full width of the source image in pixels. Observed 4500 on a Gutenberg folio.

height.description: Full height of the source image in pixels. Observed 6200 on a Gutenberg folio.

sizes.description: Precomputed size pyramid. Seven levels observed, each a halving of the previous.

tiles.description: Tile geometry. Observed: a single 256x256 tile definition with scale factors 1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128.

profile.description: Compliance profile. First element is the level URI; the second is an object enumerating the supported formats, qualities and features of this server.
